description: Discover metrics for one asset (BTC by default; ETH, SOL, XRP, TRX, BNB, DOGE, TON, LINK, HYPE, WBTC, ADA, NEAR, XLM, BCH, LTC, UNI, AVAX, SUI, HBAR, WLD, WLFI, LIT, MNT, SHIB, QNT, ENA, MORPHO, AAVE, ONDO, DOT, ZRO, PEPE, SKY, ARB, FF, POL, APT, CRV, ZAMA, SENT, ETHFI, PENDLE, ENS, FET, LDO, EIGEN, SPX, EDGE, IMX, AXS, BAT, GRT, SYRUP, FLOKI, COMP, SAND, APE, PROM, ALT, GALA, NIL or ERA) by existing category, including honest held and delayed states. Cursor pages follow the current catalogue and are not an immutable snapshot. Use it to browse by category before an asset is chosen: without one it lists BTC, and its rows are the same as get_asset_metrics gives.
name: get_metrics_list
title: Get metrics list
